title: AS2: __callTmp temp variables pollute _root scope
description: In packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts around lines 2339-2348, complex callees store temporary objects in __callTmp0, __callTmp1, etc. via ActionSetVariable at frame/DoAction scope, which permanently pollutes _root. Fix: use ActionDefineLocal (scoped to current frame) instead of ActionSetVariable, or ActionDelete2 after the call to clean up.
